scientific.integrity: The source Bernoulli quantizer is reconstructed directly. Its exact second moment reduces the variance problem to a deterministic sharp norm ratio, proved by one Cauchy--Schwarz step followed by a one-variable maximization.
limitations: The variance theorem is for one source-form TernGrad quantization bucket.
The optimization corollary is for deterministic compressed-gradient descent on \(f(x)=L\|x\|_2^2/2\).
No multiworker shared-scaler, clipping, error-feedback, or stochastic-gradient claim is made.
The sharper compressor parameter does not assert that every existing generic convergence bound becomes tight.

title: TernGrad's exact variance constant is \((\sqrt d-1)/2\)
